notes.title: Four New Announcements
notes.notes:
My name is Ternox, and I’m an indie developer. Recently, I’ve also become an indie publisher of small games — mostly visual novels — as I run the Ukrainian Visual Novel Jam and look for interesting projects that could use some help with promotion.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/25363761/88a36b136b3516cbf8ce55cf6edc23fcdccd6fbb.jpg[/img]

Together with other developers, we’ve prepared four game announcements you can already add to your wishlist.

[h1]Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: TERNOX
[b]Art[/b]: Lumeish
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E6PSbDWXbXM
Valkyrie Iteration is a mini raising sim where you train Lana to battle mysterious phantoms — beings from another dimension tearing apart the fabric of reality.

To face this threat, humanity created Valkyries — giant combat mechs with souls of their own. These living machines have instincts and personalities, accepting only pilots capable of forming a deep emotional bond with them.

Plan Lana’s days, choose which stats to train, and hope she can make it to the finale without defeat.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3466240

[h1]Manic Pixie Dreamgirls[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: Kajan Collaboration
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QNpjwkGZYVU
A team of friends is creating a nostalgic visual novel inspired by early 2000s anime. Manic Pixie Dream Girls tells the story of half-fae students who enter their classmates’ dreams, influence their subconscious, and battle nightmares.

The style blends influences from Persona, Madoka Magica, and Tumblr-era aesthetics. Key moments present three choices, one of which always leads to a bad ending. Several artists and writers work on the project with the goal of recreating the vibe of eerie, old-school anime.

The visual novel was one of the winners of Ukrainian Visual Novel Jam #5 and is now being prepared for full release on Steam. You can already support the developers by adding it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3828970

[h1]Born for the Light ~Wavelength Radiant Collapse~[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: qDrot
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VPv7onYDmVs

Solo developer qDrot is working on Born for the Light ~Wavelength Radiant Collapse~.

According to the developer, the project defies conventional expectations, exploring themes of religious trauma and illusions through the eyes of the protagonist.

The story unfolds in a world where children live high above the earth, inside a giant Tree, believing that one day they will fly to a distant Kingdom. The narrative leaves many questions unanswered, inviting players to search for meaning themselves.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3776830/

[h1]Desktop Akari ~my cute companion~[/h1]
[b]Developer[/b]: TERNOX
[b]Art[/b]: Phantom__651
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DH0RvraByjs
Remember “desktop companions” from the 2000s — when a little character would walk around your screen, sit on window edges, or perch on the Start bar? I decided to bring that idea back, but turn it into a full-fledged game — a quirky mix of idle game, raising sim, virtual friend, and even a touch of dating sim.

The main heroine is Akari from my visual novel PockeDate!, now ready to live right on your desktop. You’ll manage her schedule, give her tasks, help her study, socialize, and build her singing career, while also taking care of her mood and rest.

Desktop Akari will run over everything you do, not in a separate window, so she’ll always be there. Release is planned for early next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702590

notes.title: Big update, Free Demo and Sale!
notes.notes:
The first post-release major update for Nexoria is here! In this update combat system has been seriously changed, as well as multiple edits to the balance, a new mode, a new hero, and movement in the dungeon has become more user-friendly.

[h2]Improvements in Battle Mode:[/h2]
1. Characters in battle are now placed in invisible cells. Half of the cells are given to heroes, and half to enemies.
2. The cells are free to move in. Heroes have six cells, and characters are four. So you can move forward, move backwards, and you don't have to replace the hero.
3. Now, for a melee attack, the character will come to the front line. Thus, not only one character will take almost all the damage, you need to think about melee and long range combat.
4. Moving between cells now does not end the turn! Yes, you can step back and use the card. However, since the attack automatically uses moving to the first line, if you move to any other cell than first one, you will not be able to attack in close combat on this turn.

[h2]New mode and demo version[/h2]
Now there's a one-level "quick play" dungeon mode, made especially for the demo version, but it's also perfect if you want to check something or test a new hero. Yes, now there is a demo version with the "quick play" mode! Also the demo version doesn't offer all the heroes, but it is a great way to learn the game.

[h2]New Hero[/h2]
Because of the new battle system, the game needs to pick long-range heroes. So welcome Archer! Her attack is completely long-range and does not require any movement. 

[h2]Dungeon upgrades[/h2]
Many cells in the dungeons are now marked with an icon. You can see where your enemies are, where your treasure is, and where random events are. However, this will not save you from some traps or some random events that cannot be foreseen.

Stay with me, there's more to come!

notes.title: Nexoria 0.5 — New Heroes
notes.notes:
Sorry about the month of waiting without news, but I've been working on a major update the whole time.

Version 0.5 will bring three new heroes at once, but you will have to go through dungeons to open them. 

The game is now balanced, and strong enemies will not appear on the ground floors. The same is true for the bosses. The probability of bosses is now fixed on the floors.

A system of endings has also been introduced, each of which opens a new hero or mode. 

There will be another update soon, which will add more enemies and heroes, and we are already approaching the finish line! I hope to make the full game release in January already.

But it will not mean the end of the game's support. It will be updated and get more content.

Thanks all for testing game!

notes.title: Update 0.4 ~Balance changes~
notes.notes:
New update for you to be more interesting!

[h1]Changes in battles[/h1]
Battles take up a lot of time, and that's not bad for a roguelike. However, when one battle takes several tens of minutes to cast a monotonous attacks, it becomes boring. I've read people's feedback and made some important changes in the combat process.

[b]The amount of health of heroes and enemies is reduced.[/b]
Now every HP counts, and attacks become more dangerous, as well as spells. Any strike can be fatal, so keep an eye on your opponents' weaknesses. This has resulted in a rebalancing of spells and treatment potions, which now restore less health.

[b]Mana points are now given more often, once a second. [/b]
This allows you to cast spells more often than ever before, and not just to use default attacks endlessly. However, keep in mind that enemies can now use spells more often as well. 

[b]Animation of the attack is accelerated. [/b]
People have asked for a fast-track option, but I have decided that the attack animation should be accelerated in general, not only in the fast-track mode. You can still speed up the fight even more by holding down Ctrl.

[h1]Changes in dungeon[/h1]
The research mode also has its own problems, and I would like to answer the frequent question: "Why are the needs being wasted, even if the heroes are just pushing against the wall? The answer is simple - I would like to make players more thoughtful about their movements, and trying to memorize the map, or even sketch it, so as not to bump into walls and previously visited places. Do not  try to get to the end as quickly as possible. This game is not about rushing. And now about the update:

[b]Changed the chances of getting some events in the dungeon.[/b]
It so happens that although I have added a lot of new events, they were hardly noticed, because the chance of their falling out was extremely small. I fixed it and added a couple of new events to make you have more fun. You can even find a robot from IN-VERT, I hope you can do it.

In addition, various bugs were also fixed, for example, when deleting each item gave you a point of knowledge. Points should only be given for removing spells.

Thank you to everyone who plays and tests the game, thanks to you it will be more interesting and fun to release.

notes.title: NEXORIA
notes.notes:
Legend of Himari 2 change title to NEXORIA. After all, the arcade game turned into a tactical turn-based dungeon-crowler game. The game has become so unlike "Legend of Himari" that I decided to untie this game from any franchise and make it an independent product. But still in the Taimumari universe.

Moreover, the game will be released on February 18, but only in early access. Active participation of Steam player community is necessary for creating a quality game.

So, NEXORIA — is a hardcore roguelike about dungeons with hybrid battles, combining classical turn based combat system and a collectible card game. Collect the best spells and conquer the dungeons!

This game is a unique mix of rogue-like with dungeon exploration, RPG, turn-based tactics and collectible card game. At the base of the turn-based system are not turns, but time. Find and improve new heroes and get coins to buy new spells. But remember, a hero’s death will be fatal.
